Hi Claire — great to hear the pilot timeline. I attached a short plan comparison and a proposal (redwood_proposal_v3.pdf, HealthBridge_MA_PlanComparison.xlsx) that lays out two recommended compositions:

1) Pilot-Performance Bundle (recommended for initial eval)
   - Dedicated Performance tier: reserved pool sized for 4k rps aggregate peak (booked as 2 x p4d-equivalent units)
   - Embeddings add-on: 300k vector units/month with prefix cache enabled
   - Observability add-on: 30-day retention, eval hooks for prompt regression checks
   - Monthly list price: $68k (tokens + embeddings) — see spreadsheet for breakout

2) Conservative Pilot (lower cost)
   - Smaller dedicated fraction (burst-capable), 150k embeddings
   - Monthly list price: $39k

On upgrades/downgrades: we prorate committed capacity on a daily basis for the remainder of the billing cycle. Downgrades are allowed at the next billing renewal; for pilots we typically include a 60-day window where we offer a partial onboarding credit if they downscale (details below).

On credits: we can offer a one-time onboarding credit to offset eval costs (embedding cache warm-up and eval token runs). I will confirm internal approval for the exact credit amount and share a clean one-sheet for Finance.

Next steps: are you OK if I loop in Marissa (pricing) and Connor (solutions) to finalize the credit and the DocuSign wrapper? If so I can send a redlined SOW and a DocuSign link by Thursday.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_proposal_v3.pdf (proposal), HealthBridge_MA_PlanComparison.xlsx (cost/throughput sheet)

Marissa / Connor,

HealthBridge wants to sign a pilot by 9/24. Their preferred composition is Performance + embeddings (pilot tier 1 in my doc). They asked about onboarding credits and prorated upgrade/downgrade terms. My recommendation:

- Offer a 7% one-time contracting discount on first 3 months of committed spend (to keep ARR math conservative).
- Provide a one-time onboarding credit of $5,000 applied to the first invoice to cover eval token spend and cache warm-up.
- Add a 60-day downgrade grace: if they downscale within 60 days, they keep the onboarding credit but we prorate committed capacity back and do not refund prior usage above committed levels.

Reasoning: keeps margin intact vs bigger discounts; $5k credit is material to them for evals. If they push back, we can consider 10% but escalate to RevOps for approval.

Can you confirm we have margin to support $5k and sign-off on the 7%? Also want to make sure billing system will apply prorations as described. I can phrase this in the external message if approved.

Thanks,
Alex
